chapter_theme: A short song at Veppanchandhi (வேப்பஞ்சந்தி): the poet asks that his gaze not sink into women's breasts and praises the giver of lotus feet to devotees, the warrior vel, and Ganapati's younger brother.

755.reading: A short song: the poet asks that his gaze not settle and sink on the hills of women's breasts, and names Murugan as the one who gives his lotus feet to the devotees who hold firm. The praise names the battle in which he scattered the hosts who came against the gods, the vel that shines with the mind of Death, and Murugan as younger brother of the pot-bellied elephant god, at Veppanchandhi.
755.nuance: The song is in clipped beats, and the plea is one line: நாட்டம் தங்கிக் கொங்கைக் குவடில் படியாதே, the eye is the point of danger. கூற்றன் பந்திச் சிந்தைக் குணமொத்து ஒளிர்வேலா, a vel like Death in temper, is my reading of a hard split.
